description: STATISTICALLY-POWERED robustness check: gate-model GQC + MoE with router_split='validation' -- trains the router literally on 'the validation features' as the paper's PROSE states (Section 3.3), rather than the analysis split (this reproduction's default reading of the paper's own described procedure). n_repeats=20 (100 folds). Tests whether the paper's internal validation-vs-analysis terminology inconsistency materially changes router behavior.
